project.form: Temporary absences for head of household (Pub. 501)
project.remedy: For head of household, an absence counts as time lived with you only if it was reasonable to assume the absent person would return and you kept up the home; the time the person who would qualify you lived with you must be recounted under that rule, which this tool does not do.
